messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up — we've seen a recurring 'stream silence' pattern (partial responses that abruptly stop / timeouts) across the last 3 incidents. Need clear owners + timeline for fixes (server keepalive, client reconnects, observability). Who can take ownership?

ajay: I can own server-side sanity checks and keepalive emission. Will prototype a patch to emit periodic keepalive packets and stricter close semantics. ETA: prototype by EOW, staged rollout next sprint. Need help defining metrics to validate.

tara: I'll own dashboards & alerts. Will add queries for `partial_response_count`, `stream_last_chunk_gap_ms`, and a 5m rolling partial_rate. Can have initial dashboard + alert rules by tomorrow.

kyle: I'll take client reconnect behavior and retry windows. Proposal: add jittered exponential backoff, cap retries, and support `X-Stream-Resume` header so clients can attempt continuation rather than full restart. Plan: PR by Thu.

maria: Action item summary: ajay = server keepalive + close semantics; tara = dashboard + alerts; kyle = client retry/resume. Also need runbook updates and an ownership cadence. Who will update runbook?

oncall-sre: I'll update the runbook with a checklist for stream-silence incidents (repro steps, log queries, immediate mitigations, rollback steps). ETA: 3 business days.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created issue INF-1234: "stream-silence remediation epic". Assignees: ajay, tara, kyle, oncall-sre.

ajay: Notes from prototype plan: emitter change will send a lightweight `keepalive: true` packet every 10s. Also change streamer to only close a connection after flush + confirmation. Example log sample to look for: `stream_id=abc123 last_chunk_ms=3420 reason=socket-reset` — will add instrumentation to sample those. Canary target: us-west-2.

tara: Alert thresholds I'm proposing: trigger if `partial_response_rate` > 0.3% over 5m OR `avg_last_chunk_gap` > 2000ms. Pager if sustained >5m or spike coincides with increased error budget burn. I'll add an error-budget impact calc on the dashboard.

kyle: Client rollout plan: feature-flagged canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% across mobile/web. Adding debug headers when the flag is on to help correlate client-side reason codes. Will include tests for resume behavior.

maria: :thumbsup: Let's stand up a daily 15-min sync for the next 5 business days to track progress and blockages. I'll send the invite and update this thread with PR links, dashboard links, and canary results.

tara: Added placeholder dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/abcd/stream-silence (will replace with final after queries). Also opened alert PR.

maria: Recording owners & soft deadlines in the doc: ajay (proto by EOW -> 2498100000), tara (dashboard by 2498040000), kyle (PR by 2498050000), oncall-sre (runbook by 2498060000). Acceptance criteria: canary shows <0.05% partial_response for 48h before we close INF-1234. If regress, reopen and escalate.
